documents.content:
# Customer Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

## What makes OrganicKart produce different from regular market produce?
OrganicKart produce is grown without synthetic chemical pesticides, artificial fertilizers, GMOs, or growth hormones. All items are sourced directly from certified organic farms and local growers.

documents.title: Customer Faq
documents.content:
## How does 10-Minute Delivery work?
OrganicKart operates micro-fulfillment dark stores situated close to customer delivery locations. When an order is placed, items are picked and packed immediately and dispatched via dedicated delivery partners.

documents.title: Customer Faq
documents.content:
## How do I verify if a product is certified organic?
Products on OrganicKart display certification status badges (e.g. APPROVED by OrganicKart quality auditors). Farmers and vendors must upload valid organic certification documentation before their products are approved for sale.

documents.title: Customer Faq
documents.content:
## Can I order products by weight?
Yes! OrganicKart supports weight-based pricing for produce like apples, mangoes, potatoes, and spices (e.g. per 100g, 250g, 500g, or 1kg).

## What payment methods are supported?
OrganicKart supports secure online digital payments via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, and Wallets).

documents.title: Customer Policies
documents.content:
# OrganicKart Customer Policies & Delivery Information

## OrganicKart Delivery Policy and Hours

OrganicKart quick-commerce delivery operates 7 days a week from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM.
Orders are delivered within 10 minutes using micro-fulfillment dark stores located close to customers.
Dedicated customer support is reachable at 1800-ORGANIC or via in-app notifications.

documents.title: Customer Policies
documents.content:
## Freshness & Quality Guarantee Policy

If any delivered organic produce does not meet freshness or quality standards, customers can initiate a return or replacement request immediately through the app.

## Cancellation & Refund Policy

Orders can be cancelled prior to dispatch. Refunds for prepaid orders are processed back to the original payment source within 3-5 business days.

documents.title: Organickart Overview
documents.content:
# OrganicKart Overview

OrganicKart is India's premier quick-commerce organic marketplace. We deliver 100% certified organic fruits, vegetables, pure A2 dairy, cold-pressed oils, unpolished grains, and daily essentials straight from certified organic growers to customer kitchens in 10 minutes.

documents.title: Organickart Overview
documents.content:
## Mission
Our mission is to make authentic, lab-certified organic food accessible, affordable, and delivered at lightning speed while empowering local organic farmers with direct marketplace access.

documents.title: Organickart Overview
documents.content:
## Core Values
- 100% Lab & Admin Certified Organic: Every item listed undergoes strict quality and certification verification.
- Direct Grower Pricing: We eliminate unnecessary middlemen to give customers fair prices and farmers better earnings.
- Express 10-Minute Delivery: Temperature-controlled quick commerce fulfillment ensuring peak freshness.
- Transparency & Traceability: Customers can inspect grower details and certification credentials for listed produce.

documents.title: Organic Products
documents.content:
# Organic Products Guide

## Types of Organic Products Available on OrganicKart

OrganicKart offers a wide variety of certified organic product types across multiple categories.
Customers can browse and order the following types of organic products:

documents.title: Organic Products
documents.content:
- **Fruits**: Shimla & Kashmiri Apples, Alphonso & Kesar Mangoes, Papayas, Watermelons, Pineapples.
- **Vegetables**: Organic Tomatoes, Potatoes, Onions, Broccoli, Spinach, Carrots, Capsicum.
- **Pure A2 Dairy**: Fresh A2 Cow Milk, Pure Desi Ghee, Farm Paneer, Fresh Curd.
- **Cold-Pressed Oils**: Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil, Sesame Oil, Groundnut Oil, Extra Virgin Coconut Oil.
- **Grains & Pulses**: Unpolished Toor Dal, Moong Dal, Brown Rice, Organic Wheat Atta.

documents.title: Organic Products
documents.content:
## Benefits of Organic Fruits & Vegetables

- Higher Nutrient Content: Organic fruits and vegetables often contain higher levels of antioxidants, vitamin C, and essential minerals like iron, magnesium, and chromium.
- Zero Harmful Pesticide Residue: Protects long-term health by eliminating intake of toxic agricultural chemicals.
- Richer Natural Taste: Grown in nutrient-dense organic soil, natural flavors and aromas are preserved.
- Environmentally Sustainable: Organic farming protects soil health, reduces water pollution, and promotes biodiversity.
